subject.title: fix(ui): back off unavailable session PR polling

question: Should the connection-scoped suppression policy remain reconnect-reset only for non-retryable `UNAVAILABLE`, or should maintainers require a live recovery demonstration before accepting that UX tradeoff?
rationale: The diff makes a deliberate UI availability tradeoff rather than only changing request frequency, and the supplied evidence does not show the post-fix behavior against a real unavailable gateway followed by recovery.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Request a redacted gateway/UI run showing the request rate becomes bounded and returns after the intended retry or reconnect path.

options.title: Accept the tested policy
options.body: Accept the existing unit coverage and production incident evidence as sufficient for the reconnect-reset behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted gateway/UI run showing the request rate becomes bounded and returns after the intended retry or reconnect path.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context identifies steipete as the implementation author and source of the production incident evidence; broader ownership could not be independently traced here.
